baseTemplate.title: Blockchain & Crypto Platform Co-op Student - AssetGrid
baseTemplate.description:
Join TAURUS AI CORP's AssetGrid Crypto Platform team as a Co-op Student and dive into the exciting world of blockchain technology, cryptocurrency platforms, and decentralized finance (DeFi). Work on cutting-edge crypto trading platforms and blockchain infrastructure that powers the future of digital assets.

**About AssetGrid:**
AssetGrid is our comprehensive cryptocurrency platform offering trading, portfolio management, and blockchain infrastructure services. You'll work on systems that handle real-time crypto trading, smart contract integration, and secure asset management.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Assist in developing and testing blockchain and crypto trading features
- Contribute to smart contract development and testing
- Help optimize trading algorithms and platform performance
- Support security audits and compliance checks
- Participate in technical research on blockchain technologies
- Document technical specifications and user guides
- Assist with API integrations and third-party services

**Learning Opportunities:**
- Gain deep understanding of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies
- Learn about DeFi protocols and smart contract development
- Experience real-time trading system architecture
- Understand crypto security best practices
- Work with Web3 technologies and blockchain APIs
- Learn about financial technology and trading systems

**Duration:** 4-8 months
**Start Date:** Flexible (typically January, May, or September)
**Location:** Remote/Hybrid options available
requirements: Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Blockchain, or related program
Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, or Solidity
Interest in blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies
Good understanding of data structures and algorithms
Ability to work with complex technical systems
preferredQualifications: Experience with blockchain development (Ethereum, Solana, etc.)
Knowledge of smart contract development (Solidity, Rust)
Familiarity with Web3 libraries and frameworks
benefits: Mentorship from blockchain and crypto experts
